name: proworks-engine-suite
description: ForgeIQ, CostIQ, Prime, and ReceiptIQ — portable intelligence engines. Hosts consume them; they depend on no host.
author: Steven Kreutzer

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/intelligence-core packages/model-runtime packages/model-evals packages/platform-events packages/platform-runtime packages/forgeiq packages/costiq packages/workorderiq packages/prime packages/receiptiq packages/tracking packages/inventoryiq packages/notifications packages/order-ingestion packages/visioniq packages/control-plane
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/contracts packages/intelligence-core packages/model-runtime packages/model-evals packages/platform-events packages/platform-runtime packages/forgeiq packages/costiq packages/workorderiq packages/prime packages/receiptiq packages/tracking packages/inventoryiq packages/notifications packages/order-ingestion packages/visioniq packages/control-plane
